_meta.note: KAS 0.66.70 (the @kiro/agent package.json kiro-cli 2.36.0 installs) reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3 --auth-method cli`, the production relay spawn, driven over stdio by a scratch client whose initialize sent Crew's own KAS_CLIENT_CAPABILITIES (`_meta.kiro` = settings {} and openExternalUrl true). session/new named one http MCP server, `oauth-probe`, at a scratch endpoint on the loopback interface that answers every MCP call 401 with an RFC 9728 resource_metadata pointer and serves RFC 8414 metadata plus RFC 7591 registration (it never issues a token). The client then sent what AcpRuntime.begin_mcp_sign_in sends, `_kiro/mcp/resetServer` {sessionId, serverName: oauth-probe, startOAuth: true}, and the engine asked it to open the consent URL as a `_kiro/openExternalUrl` request whose params carry only that url. The client answered {} and closed before any sign-in. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id and every engine-minted uuid are replaced with fixed synthetic values at capture, the scratch work dir reads as /work and the home directory as ~. Host-local values are normalized at capture: the scratch endpoint's loopback host and port read as oauth-probe.invalid:40001, the engine's own loopback callback host and port (inside redirect_uri) as loopback.invalid:40002, and the PKCE code_challenge as a synthetic value; the url's path and every query key are as the engine sent them. Kept: the initialize response (KAS by its extensionMethods, no agentInfo), the session/new response TRIMMED to sessionId and modes.currentModeId, and the openExternalUrl request. Omitted: host inventory (_kiro/* notifications and every session/update).
